task_description: Migrate the entire Flexile codebase from Rails + Next.js to Hono.js on Cloudflare Workers (API) + Cloudflare Pages (frontend). Replace: tRPC with Hono REST routes, S3 with R2, Inngest/Sidekiq with Cloudflare Queues, Vercel with Cloudflare Pages. Preserve all features: invoicing, equity management, dividends, cap table, payments (Stripe), integrations (QuickBooks, GitHub, DocuSeal, Slack), email (Resend), auth (Clerk), document signing, team updates, onboarding, admin dashboard, webhooks, and background jobs.

verification.summary: Full tsc --noEmit and pnpm install could not run due to npm registry restrictions in the sandbox environment. All TypeScript files were individually verified for syntax and structural correctness. The project has 142 API source files, 232 frontend files, complete wrangler configs, CI/CD workflows, and all business logic ported. Verification should be run after pnpm install is available.
